name: glass_apiary
theme: a golden apiary at sunset — orchard to hive to honeycomb to one wax cell of honey, into a sugar crystal's cubic lattice that folds out into a globular star cluster, then amber nebula dust lanes and a honey-gold planet down to the orchard again

registers.name: apiary
registers.palette: sunset amber and warm honey gold
registers.scene: a wide sunset apiary orchard seen from a low rise at the end of the rows, blossoming fruit trees in long ranks under a deep amber sky, dry grass and clover between the trunks, a line of pale wooden hive boxes standing at the edge of the nearest row
registers.target: a pale wooden beehive box, weathered square supers stacked one on another
registers.loop_target: the sunset apiary orchard, blossoming trees in long ranks under an amber sky, pale wooden hive boxes at the edge of the rows

registers.name: hive
registers.palette: pale wax white and cool shadowed brown
registers.scene: the open top of a beehive box in the orchard grass, tiers of wooden frames drawn thick with wax comb, a haze of bees across the ribbed surfaces, blossoming branches past the hive's edge, pale wax and deep shadow in the gaps between the frames
registers.target: a frame of golden honeycomb, a close-packed field of six-sided wax cells

registers.name: honeycomb
registers.scene: a wall of honeycomb running off in every direction, a tight hexagonal grid of six-sided wax cells, amber walls lit from within the wax, some caps sealed pale and others open on dark gold, the wooden frame edge beyond
registers.target: an open wax cell full of dark gold honey, six straight walls

registers.name: honey_cell
registers.scene: the inside of a single wax cell, six walls of dull gold wax on every side, thick dark honey pooled across the floor in a heavy amber glow
registers.target: a small clear sugar crystal, a hard cube with flat square facets

registers.name: sugar_crystal
registers.palette: clear pale gold and cold white glint
registers.scene: a clear cubic sugar crystal among its neighbours, flat square faces and sharp straight edges, hard pale gold planes meeting at right angles, more cubes stacked away behind it
registers.target: a cubic lattice of bright nodes, small glowing points joined by straight struts

registers.name: lattice
registers.scene: a vast cubic lattice of bright nodes in perfect ordered ranks, straight struts running in three directions through deep indigo dark, a cold pale-blue spark at every junction

registers.name: star_swarm
registers.scene: a globular cluster of a million golden stars packed into one great round swarm, blazing amber at the crowded core and thinning to scattered points against the black
registers.target: an amber nebula, thick bronze dust lanes across glowing gold gas

registers.name: dust_lanes
registers.scene: a great amber nebula, bronze dust lanes carved in dark channels through vast sheets of glowing gold gas, deep indigo dark beyond the folds
registers.target: a round banded planet of honey gold, pale-gold and amber cloud bands

registers.name: honey_planet
registers.scene: an enormous honey-gold planet hangs in space, broad pale-gold and amber cloud bands wrapped around its curve, one dark storm eye in the south, black space beyond the bright limb
registers.target: a clear round gap in the cloud bands

registers.name: orchard_country
registers.palette: deep orchard green and low amber sunlight
registers.scene: sunlit orchard country seen from high above, long ranks of blossoming fruit trees quilting the low green hills, hedgerows and dirt lanes between the blocks, low amber light across the rows

music_theme: a golden apiary at sunset, warm and humming, hymn-like strings over a low drone, one bright bloom of sound landing on the crystal-lattice fold into the star swarm
